title: Part 7 閱讀理解
summary: 讀廣告和簡訊，先看題目再找答案。

steps.title: Part 7 是什麼
body: Part 7 是閱讀理解：廣告、email、公告、簡訊對話等，每篇有 2～5 題。
秘訣：先看題目，再回文章找關鍵字。遇到 What is true…? 要一個一個選項對照文章。

steps.title: 常見問法
body: 看懂題目在問什麼，就成功一半：
steps.tip: 答案常是文章的「換句話說」：Saturday and Sunday ＝ on weekends。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 每題都會顯示文章，看完題目再回文章找答案。

questions.explanation: We are looking for a part-time server. 徵兼職服務生。
questions.sentence: What job is the café offering?
questions.text:
Sunny Café — Now Hiring!
We are looking for a part-time server.
• Hours: Saturday and Sunday, 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.
• Pay: $15 per hour
• Experience is helpful but not necessary.
To apply, please send your résumé to jobs@sunnycafe.com by April 10.

questions.explanation: Saturday and Sunday 換句話說就是 on weekends（週末）。

Sarah (9:17): No problem. The client meeting is at 10:30, so you have time.
Mike (9:18): Great. Could you print the sales report for me?
Sarah (9:20): Sure. I'll put it on your desk.
